learningGoals: Identify visual patterns in everyday objects and decorations. 🪔
Create simple, repeating patterns using shapes, colors, or objects. 🎨
Understand the basic concept of symmetry in decorations. 🦋
Logically guess and extend a given pattern sequence. 🧠
teachingTips: Look for repeating patterns in clothes, bedsheets, or floor tiles and discuss them. 👕
Involve your child in making simple rangoli, paper chains, or flower arrangements during festivals. 🌼
Create sound patterns by clapping and snapping (e.g., clap-snap-clap-snap) and ask them to copy. 👏
When lining up toys or fruits, intentionally create a pattern and ask 'What comes next?' 🍎

funActivities.title: Veggie Printing Patterns 🧅
funActivities.description: Cut a ladyfinger or potato in half, dip it in paint, and stamp a repeating color pattern on paper.

funActivities.title: Bindi Patterns 🔴
funActivities.description: Use colorful bindis to make a sequence in a notebook, like red-blue-red-blue, and ask them to finish the line.

funActivities.title: Festival Garland 🍃
funActivities.description: Help your child thread beads, macaroni, or leaves on a string in a repeating pattern to make a lovely garland.
